market_summary: Late New York session trading is characterized by post-expansion consolidation across major asset classes. Precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD), EURUSD, and GBPUSD are stuck in low-volume, sub-VWAP and sub-VAL ranges following earlier intraday selloffs, lacking fresh RVOL breakout confirmation. US100 maintains bullish structural trend above VWAP, but price is pressing directly against Call Wall #1 in a positive dampening GEX regime, restricting long upside while offering no confirmed short trigger. BTCUSD is rotating mid-range along its VAL and EMA20. All six instruments present low-probability conditions, warranting patient HOLD stances.

signals.rationale: In NEW_YORK_SESSION, XAUUSD trades at 3881.66, situated below VAL (3890.82) and below POC (3978.13). CVD is BEARISH (-7.39) with a short-term positive slope (+0.99), showing mild divergence on the bounce from Session Low (3852.35). Trend remains bearish below VWAP (3932.51) and EMA50 (3913.12). Price is consolidating mid-channel between EMA20 (3884.91) and the lower ATR band (3865.34). RVOL is low at 0.79 with no yellow volume confirmation. GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING, with price hovering just above the Gamma Flip (3871.29) and far below Call Wall #1 (4149.06), with Put Wall #1 down at 3821.50. Dampened mean-reversion conditions and lack of volume dictate standing aside.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish - trading well below downward-sloping session VWAP
